reading: The sketch lays out an issue-tracker detail page: a full-height pale sidebar nav on the left with two link groups, a small grey breadcrumb at the top of the main column, a docs-style article (title, paragraph, code block, activity log, comment) in the main column, a status-change dropdown overlapping that article, and a right-hand properties panel listing status/priority/assignee/labels/cycle/estimate.

actions.instruction: Add a flat pale-grey side nav panel spanning the full height of the page at the left edge: #f7f7f8 fill from the very top to the very bottom, 220px wide, square
Add a small grey breadcrumb reading 'Lumen > Web > LUM-482' near the top of the main content column, text colour #8a8f98 (grey, not the page's near-black text).
Add a docs-style article block (not a plain card, not a bare table) in the main content column, flush at its top with no padding above the title, stacked top to
Add a 'Change Status' dropdown panel that floats over the article content, listing status options in small grey spaced capitals under a 'STATUS' label, one row
Add a right-hand properties panel column listing issue metadata as label/value rows: 'Status' label (#8a8f98) with value 'In Progress' (#1c1d1f) and a yellow #f
